title: P2 spend.reconcile: request
description: farmctl spend reconcile --file (from the provider report file) or a process outside the core with its own report key hands in the provider's daily sum per workspace, one request per UTC day. The core compares it with the sum of its own lines for the same day with a tolerance from the deployment settings, writes the difference as one signed correction line, and the spend_estimated lines of that day get the spend_reconciled flag without a price edit (BUD-10, D-87 (1)). This is a contract between programs.

spent_eur_micros.description: The provider's daily sum per workspace in micro-euros.

rows.description: The provider's daily sums: the whole report of the day in one request, never a part of it; a workspace with usage that day and no row is reconciled to zero. An empty list says the provider's report has no usage for the day, which still counts as the day's report (RET-6).
